categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of non-road diesel engines and related components. The company specializes in multi-cylinder diesel engines for non-road applications, serving industries such as construction machinery, agricultural machinery, and power generation equipment. Main product categories include engines for forklifts, excavators, loaders, tractors, and harvesters.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced manufacturing processes for diesel engines, including precision machining of key components, engine assembly, and comprehensive testing capabilities. Core technologies include engine design for high rigidity and strength, torque reserve optimization, and speed regulation performance. The company has established a complete production system with self-built casting workshops for critical components like engine blocks and cylinder heads. Manufacturing adheres to non-road Stage IV and EU Stage V emission standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in construction machinery (forklifts, excavators, loaders), agricultural machinery (tractors, harvesters), and power generation sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with domestic sales representing 99.63% of revenue. Key customer segments include major machinery manufacturers such as Anhui Heli, Jiangsu Wode Agricultural Machinery, Hangzhou Forklift Group, and Shandong Liugong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main manufacturing facilities in Xinchang County, Zhejiang Province. The company has established a multi-level service network including market service centers, regional parts distribution centers, and authorized service stations covering major provinces and cities across China. Limited international operations with exports representing 0.37% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures finished diesel engines and components for sale to OEM customers in construction and agricultural machinery industries. The company controls key production stages including casting, machining, assembly, and testing, while sourcing raw materials and components from qualified suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous technology innovation and product development aligned with emission standards and market demands. Key R&D initiatives include developing Stage IV and Stage V compliant engines, multi-fuel engines (dual-fuel LPG), electric hybrid powertrains, and engine electrification components. The company invests approximately 3.31% of revenue in R&D, with 195 R&D personnel. Strategic priorities include product quality enhancement, cost reduction, market expansion in agricultural machinery and large-tonnage forklifts, and development of new energy solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of diesel engines and related components to OEM customers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery or pickup. The company uses both direct sales (88.09% of revenue) and distributor channels (11.91%). Pricing is based on market conditions and negotiated with major customers through annual framework agreements. The company also generates minor revenue from other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading manufacturer in the non-road diesel engine market, ranking first in market share for construction machinery diesel engines and among the top ten in multi-cylinder diesel engines and agricultural machinery engines according to China Internal Combustion Engine Industry Association data. The company competes on quality, cost, technology, and service advantages. Key competitive strengths include long-term industry focus, customer relationships, manufacturing expertise, and established brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 2.316 billion, representing 10.58% growth from 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 31.96 million (44.14% increase). Total assets reached RMB 2.651 billion. The company achieved profitability with a 9.15% gross margin. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2021 and maintains stable operations with consistent revenue generation from core business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high cost-performance ratio, environmental protection, and reliability. Key differentiators include: (1) specialized focus on non-road diesel engines with deep understanding of application characteristics; (2) advanced manufacturing processes and quality control; (3) comprehensive service network with integrated sales and after-sales support; (4) compliance with stringent emission standards (Stage IV and EU Stage V); (5) continuous product innovation and customization capabilities; (6) established brand reputation and customer relationships with major OEMs; (7) cost advantages from scale production and vertical integration including in-house casting operations.
